assignments.rationale: The repository is the official Python client and CLI for model/dataset/Space Hub discovery, versioned repository access, caching, upload/commit operations, and registry-style metadata APIs. These are its primary public capabilities, not merely an optional integration.

evidence.description: The project identifies itself as the official CLI and Python client for the Hugging Face Hub and lists downloading, uploading, repository management, search, inference, cards, and CLI workflows.
Package metadata describes a client for downloading and publishing models, datasets, and other Hub repositories and exposes the hf CLI entry point.
The primary repository guide covers listing, creating, deleting, duplicating, uploading/downloading, copying, branches/tags, settings, and search for Hub repositories.
The HfApi implementation provides model/dataset/Space info types and repository, file, commit, revision, collection, and Hub API operations.

public_bundle_note: The original checkout path is intentionally omitted from this public example bundle.
